zh: 这件夹克对我来说太小了。
en: This jacket is {too|way too|far too} small for me.

zh: 我只需要牛奶和面包。
en: I {only|just} need milk and bread.

zh: 这双鞋在网上便宜得多。
en: These shoes are {much|far|way|a lot} cheaper online.

zh: 我现在几乎从不去商场了。
en: I {hardly ever|almost never|rarely|seldom} go to the mall these days.

zh: 这个颜色正是我想找的。
en: The colour is {exactly|just|precisely} what I was looking for.

zh: 这个稍微贵一点，但质量更好。
en: This one is {slightly|a bit|a little} more expensive, but the quality is better.

zh: 我只是随便看看，谢谢。
en: I'm {just|only} looking, thanks.

zh: 很遗憾，那款没有您的尺码了。
en: {Unfortunately|Sadly}, we don't have that in your size.

zh: 这家店因装修暂时关门。
en: The shop is {temporarily} closed for renovations.

zh: 我有时候会买些其实并不需要的东西。
en: I {sometimes|occasionally} buy things I don't really need.

zh: 一件T恤卖这个价，实在是贵得太离谱了。
en: That's {way|far|much} too expensive for a T-shirt.

zh: 我买它主要是因为在打折。
en: I bought it {mainly|mostly|largely} because it was on sale.

zh: 我们可以分开付款吗？
en: Can we pay {separately}?

zh: 它便宜得离谱，所以我买了两个。
en: It was {ridiculously|incredibly|unbelievably|insanely} cheap, so I bought two.

zh: 我就要这件了。其实……我能先试一下蓝色的吗？
en: I'll take this one. {Actually}, can I try the blue one first?

zh: 等了三个星期，我的订单终于到了。
en: My order has {finally} arrived after three weeks.

zh: 把小票留好，否则就退不了货了。
en: Keep the receipt, {otherwise|or|or else} you won't be able to return it.

zh: 附近有超市吗？
en: Is there a supermarket {nearby|close by|near here|around here}?

zh: 它挺贵的，但我很喜欢。
en: It's {quite|pretty|fairly|rather} expensive, but I love it.

zh: 这个牌子据说是最好的，但我不太信。
en: This brand is {supposedly|apparently|allegedly} the best, but I'm not convinced.
